svd.sign_convention: Largest-magnitude coordinate is positive; tied singular subspaces remain nonunique

logit_lens.interpretation: Signed cosines use canonical SVD orientation; absolute values ignore arbitrary direction sign. Named rows do not search the whole vocabulary.
logit_lens.tying_verification: Caller must verify this tensor is the unembedding or tied embedding

public_serialization_note: The inspector's logit_lens.token_ids map is named vocabulary_row_ids here to distinguish five named vocabulary rows from raw generation token sequences. Numeric results are unchanged.
rounding_note: SVD rank includes bf16 rounding residuals; rank-one energy and projection residual quantify approximation. Base hashes validate listed tensors, not the entire checkpoint.
